rationale: The short thesis has been invalidated: price has recovered from the $21.89 entry back to $22.02, essentially at session VWAP ($22.03) and now above the 5m 9-EMA ($21.87), just $0.03 shy of the $22.05 stop. The last candle printed the heaviest volume of the recent sequence while closing at the highs, showing upward pressure against the position, and with only $195.91 of daily loss budget left, holding into the stop is poor risk. I see no meaningfully stronger evidence for a fresh long (stock is still ~5% off highs and near the lower third of its range), so I close to flat rather than flip.
